notes: NScripter/ONScripter: nscript.dat is the engine's own (obfuscated) script file and 0.txt its plain-text form -- ONScripter's script loader looks for exactly those names (https://github.com/Galladite27/ONScripter-EN/blob/master/ScriptHandler.cpp); .nsa/.sar are its resource archives (https://github.com/matthewn4444/onscripter-engine-android, https://morkt.github.io/GARbro/supported.html). No enginehost plugin yet, so Windows builds go to Wine.
